title: Comparative Study of Deep Learning Architectures for Brain Tumour Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.34781v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate and early classification of brain tumours from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for treatment planning, yet many published deep learning studies are trained and tested on small, single-source datasets, reporting accuracies that may not hold outside these datasets. This study compares six deep learning architectures for four-class classification (healthy, meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumour): a baseline convolutional neural network (CNN), an attention-based CNN, ShuffleNet, and EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50 and Xception augmented with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). The models were trained on a corpus assembled from four publicly available MRI datasets. Because these datasets carry no patient identifiers, a leakage-aware pipeline was developed that removes exact duplicates using MD5 hashing (550 images) and near-duplicates using perceptual hashing (8,024 images), and assigns visually similar image

translated_title: 脑肿瘤分类深度学习架构的比较研究
translated_abstract: 从磁共振成像（MRI）中对脑肿瘤进行准确且早期的分类对于治疗规划至关重要，然而许多已发表的深度学习研究是在小型、单源数据集上训练和测试的，其报告的准确率在这些数据集之外可能并不成立。本研究比较了六种深度学习架构在四分类任务（健康、脑膜瘤、胶质瘤和垂体瘤）上的表现：基线卷积神经网络（CNN）、基于注意力的CNN、ShuffleNet，以及通过卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）增强的EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50和Xception。这些模型在由四个公开MRI数据集汇编而成的语料库上进行训练。由于这些数据集不含患者标识信息，研究开发了一种防泄漏的处理流程：使用MD5哈希去除完全重复的图像（550张），使用感知哈希去除近似重复的图像（8,024张），并对视觉相似的图像进行……
tldr: 本研究比较了六种深度学习架构在多源MRI数据集上脑肿瘤四分类任务中的表现，并提出了利用MD5哈希和感知哈希去除重复图像的防数据泄漏流程，以更真实地评估模型的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This study compares six deep learning architectures for four-class brain tumour classification on a multi-source MRI corpus and develops a leakage-aware pipeline using MD5 and perceptual hashing to remove duplicate images, enabling more realistic evaluation of model generalization.
